messages:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing a burst of tiny-pod evictions in us-west1 around 02:12 UTC. eviction rate spiked ~4x for GPU pools.
maya: saw that, looks correlated with a short egress network surge from rack-03. lots of nodes briefly flapped Ready->NotReady.
jordan: the scheduler reacted by rescheduling tiny GPU jobs which caused binpack churn and some warm-pool losses. warmpool-us-west1a dropped several warmpool-backed pods.
lia: logs from node gpu-rack-03-node-11 show kubelet reconnect spikes and kube-proxy conntrack errors: ``conntrack: table full`` then backlog.
ops-bot: alert: scheduler_eviction_surge — 6139990005 — group: gpu-pools — severity: high — link: https://grafana.internal/alerts/6139990005
alex: quick repro command I used: ``kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending`` — shows many tiny <0.1 rps jobs bouncing.
maya: cost hit is annoying — repeated restarts multiplied token/time cost on Dedicated pools. we should avoid full reschedules on transient node flaps.
jordan: idea: temporarily bias scheduler scoring to prefer binpack (reduce fragmentation) and lower preemption aggressiveness for tiny pods. can flip a feature-gate in the scheduler config.
lia: also we can set a short-taint toleration on warmpool nodes so they aren't evicted by transient NotReady. e.g., add tolerationSeconds to tolerate NotReady for 60s for critical warmpool pods.
alex: we patched kube-scheduler (configmap) to increase node-rediscovery-delay from 0s to 10s and nudged preemptionConformance to less aggressive — rolling now in us-west1 (will monitor).
maya: doing a targeted drain of the worst nodes (gpu-rack-03-node-11, gpu-rack-03-node-12) would be risky — prefer cordon + cordon-delay to let transient heal.
jordan: long-term ops: we should add a conntrack autoscaler on the rack NAT boxes and improve conntrack table limits in kube-proxy config for high eviction-resilience.
lia: opened infra ticket INFRA-8272 with timeline and suggested mitigations. tagging @networking and @scheduling.
ops-bot: note: rolling scheduler config update started — 6139990055 — rollout id rsched-2026-03-21-1
alex: tl;dr: root cause = short egress/conntrack saturation -> node readiness flaps -> scheduler binpack churn -> tiny-pod eviction cascade. mitigation in progress: scheduler backoff + tolerationSeconds + conntrack followup.
maya: I'll keep an eye on cost dashboard and revert schedule changes if we see worse perf. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jordan: if anyone spots a repeat spike ping here, we'll escalate to P1.
lia: sharing a quick diagnostic snippet for followups:
```
# check node conntrack and kube-proxy
kubectl -n kube-system logs daemonset/kube-proxy -l node=gpu-rack-03-node-11 | tail -n 100
sudo conntrack -S | head
# check warmpool state
kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=warmpool-us-west1a -o wide
```
alex: thanks — heading to follow up with networking. will update thread when alerts clear.
